snippet.title: Supermarket Guard Simulator - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam 👉👉👉https://store.steampowered.com/app/3720580/Supermarket_Guard_Simulator/

Announcement trailer for our upcoming game 'Supermarket Guard Simulator' 👮.
In which you play as supermarket security guard and your job is to prevent shoplifting and drive company profits to keep shareholders happy, regardless of the cost. Setup security systems, catch thieves, take on orders from management.

#indiegame #simulatorgames #gamedev #games
